title: Shortfall margin on straight-tip catheter liability notices, Continence Original Medicare Program
content:
A liability notice for straight-tip intermittent catheters (A4351) on the Continence Original Medicare Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program may carry extra units for each of its notice blocks. The extra units depend on the customer's recent shortfalls and order changes.

## Questions answered

**When are 10 units per 30 days added?**
When a refill of the program shipped by customer-requested expedited shipping within the last 12 calendar months. Then 10 units per 30 days are added to the notice units for each of the notice blocks. An expedite recorded at no charge, made only to make up for a delay Larkfield caused, is not customer-requested expedited shipping.

**When are 5 units per 30 days added?**
When no such expedited refill shipped, and the newest written order asks more than the earlier order and is dated no more than 60 calendar days before the signing date. Then 5 units per 30 days are added for each of the notice blocks.

**And otherwise?**
Otherwise nothing is added.

**Which orders are compared?**
The newest written order is the straight-tip order with the latest order date. The earlier order is the written order behind the authorization grant that the previous refill drew on, the previous refill being the program's straight-tip refill with the latest ship date. A program with no earlier straight-tip refill has no earlier order, so the 5-unit addition cannot apply to it.

**How is "within the last 12 calendar months" read?**
A refill dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the signing date is within it.

## Decision table (hypothetical; 4 notice blocks)

| Customer-requested expedited refill in the last 12 months | Newest order asks more than the earlier order | Newest order dated before signing | Units added |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | any | any | 10 times 4, which is 40 |
| no | yes | 60 days | 5 times 4, which is 20 |
| no | yes | 61 days | none |
| no | no | any | none |
